svg.title: LiteLLM Gateway and Multi-Subscription Azure Foundry Supply Pools
svg.desc: Layered architecture showing consumer applications and scheduled jobs entering a LiteLLM gateway on AKS, which routes user-facing model names to five isolation groups across ten Claude Foundry subscriptions, five GPT subscriptions, two dedicated batch subscriptions, one DeepSeek subscription, and a cross-cloud Vertex Claude backup channel.
svg.text: LiteLLM Gateway + Multi-Subscription Azure Foundry Supply Pools
18 subscriptions · eastus2 · GlobalStandard deployments · ~1000 employees across 5 teams

g.text: Employee IDE — VS Code + GitHub Copilot
L5 · Vibe Coding · NOT a LiteLLM backend
10 subscriptions × 3 endpoints = 30 endpoints · Opus / Sonnet / Haiku
2 subscriptions per group — a suspended group costs 20% of capacity
First fallback for every Claude group

svg.text: Region eastus2 · SKU GlobalStandard · one Foundry account per subscription: fdry-{subscription_name} / proj-{subscription_name} · names are placeholders
